snippet.title: House of 1000 Doors: Family Secrets
snippet.description:
iPad: http://bigfi.sh/16RbszX
iPhone: http://bigfi.sh/16ien5H

Guide Kate Reed as she solves four mind-bending mysteries that take her to worlds she's never imagined

• COMMUNICATE WITH SPIRITS!
When the dead cannot find release, the House of 1000 Doors serves as a portal that allows the living to help them.

• UNLOCK THIS COLLECTOR'S EDITION AND GAIN ACCESS TO AMAZING BONUSES!
Use the strategy guide to help you get through any of those tricky parts and check out the the additional bonus chapter of the game.

• TRAVEL TO OTHER WORLDS!
Experience over 80 locations in the past and the present while working your way through over 20 mini-games and countless Hidden Object Scenes!

• SOLVE MIND-BENDING MYSTERIES!
Meet the enigmatic Lancaster family that resides within the spooky house and help solve 4 mysteries
